samples.summary: Backend block-alignment value validation is unrequested scope, unrelated to the issue, and changes the REST contract
samples.evidence: The originating issue/task (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md) is entirely about the color reset (`applyStyle({color:""})` → `undefined`) and the renderer/exporter color guards; its Plan and Non-goals never mention block alignment or backend payload validation. This diff adds `BLOCK_ALIGNMENTS` + `assertValidBlockStyle` to `PUT /content`, turning payloads that were previously accepted (any alignment string, e.g. from an older schema or an importer variant) into HTTP 400. It also breaks the stated contract of the surrounding validator, whose own doc comment says it throws "on the first *shape* problem" — this is the only value-level rule, and only for alignment, while colors (the actual subject of the issue) are still accepted unvalidated. Ships a REST behavior change under a rendering bug fix.

verdict.reason: Verified in-tree: `BLOCK_ALIGNMENTS` (docs-content.controller.ts:254) and `assertValidBlockStyle` (:266-279) are live on the `PUT /content` path via `assertValidBlock` (:295) ← `assertValidDocsBody` (:250) ← `putContent` (:143), rejecting any alignment string outside left/center/right/justify with HTTP 400, including inside table cells (:322). It is the only value-level rule in a validator whose own docblock (:217-221) states it throws on the first *shape* problem, and colors — the actual subject of the issue — remain unvalidated. The originating task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md) is entirely about the color reset, renderer falsy-color guard and DOCX/PPTX color normalization; its Plan (23-100), Acceptance criteria (102-105) and Non-goals (107-112) never mention block alignment or backend payload validation. The related lessons file (20260812-docs-font-color-reset-lessons.md:30-38) says the fix belongs at the sink, and that sink guard already exists (packages/docs/src/export/docx-style-map.ts:141, closed `DOCX_ALIGNMENTS` lookup), so the API-level 400 is additional unrequested REST-contract change. No guard makes it unreachable, no design doc or criterion requests it, and scope creep is squarely inside the design-fit lane as a `major` fit violation. No named refutation ground applies.

verdict.reason:
The code exists as quoted: `DOCX_ALIGNMENTS` (docx-style-map.ts:115-120) and `DOCX_ALIGNMENTS[style.alignment as string] ?? 'left'` (docx-style-map.ts:141). But under this lens's rubric it is not a blocking (`major`) fit violation — it is a taste/process preference ("belongs in its own change"), which is `minor` and never blocks:

1. No stated Non-Goal is exceeded. The task's Non-goals (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md:107-112) are limited to the color palette/picker UI, highlight rendering, and document migration. Alignment is not among them.
2. No acceptance criterion is failed. The criterion ("reset the text color → the text is uncolored", todo.md:102-105) is addressed by the renderer/store/export color work (todo.md:23-72); the alignment lookup neither removes nor weakens any of it.
3. It is not duplication/reinvention — it deliberately mirrors the pre-existing sibling pattern in the PPTX exporter (`ALGN[block.style.alignment] ?? 'l'`, packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:61-79), i.e. reuse of the repo's established closed-lookup idiom at the adjacent OOXML sink in the *same function* (`buildParagraphPropertiesXml`) and the *same defect class* the issue is about (untrusted persisted style string interpolated into an OOXML value-typed attribute).
4. Design-doc discipline is satisfied, not violated: the behavior is folded into the canonical subsystem doc's "export is not lenient" table (docs/design/docs/docs-docx-import-export.md:436-441, `<w:jc w:val>` → `DOCX_ALIGNMENTS` lookup → falls back to `left`), and the rationale is recorded as a review-driven follow-up in the paired lessons file (20260812-docs-font-color-reset-lessons.md:30-38). No parallel/duplicate doc was created.
5. The secondary behavior-change claim is also weak: `BlockStyle.alignment` is a closed union of exactly those four tokens (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:103), and the API now rejects anything else (packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts:254-279), so no legitimate value is "dropped to left" — the fallback is the intended fail-closed behavior documented in the design doc.

Real code, in-lane subject matter, but `minor`-kind scope preference rather than a blocking fit violation.

finding.summary: New OOXML export color policy is not recorded in any design doc (CONTRIBUTING requires updating the canonical subsystem doc for non-trivial changes)
finding.evidence: The diff changes documented export mappings — `docs-docx-import-export.md:299-312` still states the plain `<w:color w:val>` / `<w:shd w:fill>` ↔ `style.color`/`backgroundColor` correspondence, and `slides-pptx-export.md:148-151` still documents `{kind:'srgb'} → <a:srgbClr val="RRGGBB">` unconditionally, with no mention of the new rules introduced here (non-hex values drop the attribute/child, fully transparent colors drop, partial alpha renders opaque, `''` means unset).
